claims.text: AlCoCrFeNi2.1 is a eutectic high-entropy alloy.
As-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 has a fine lamellar FCC/B2 microstructure.
The FCC lamellae are soft and ductile, whereas the ordered B2 phase is brittle and continuous.
A solution treatment, rapid quench, and intermediate-temperature anneal can invert the as-cast eutectic microstructure.
The solutionizing temperature must exceed the order-disorder transition temperature to dissolve the continuous ordered phase.
Annealing at approximately 600°C for an optimized time will reprecipitate the brittle phase as discrete particles without excessive coarsening.
The proposed processing must be performed under an inert atmosphere.
The treatment will produce a continuous ductile FCC matrix containing finely distributed discrete B2 particles.
The treatment will refine the lamellar spacing.
Discrete B2 precipitates in an FCC matrix will increase dislocation storage and provide barrier strengthening.
Breaking up the continuous brittle phase will enable more uniform plastic deformation.
The combined strengthening and more uniform deformation mechanisms will simultaneously increase strength and ductility.
As-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 has a room-temperature fracture stress of about 944 MPa and elongation of about 25.6%.
The inverted microstructure will approach or exceed 1300 MPa in yield or ultimate tensile strength.
The inverted microstructure will retain at least 25% tensile elongation and may improve ductility relative to the as-cast state.
The proposed benefit should hold at room temperature and moderate service temperatures.
The intervention is applicable to eutectic HEAs containing an ordered brittle phase that can be redistributed.
Over-aging or coarsening can limit the mechanical benefit if the thermal parameters are not controlled.

contradictions.description: The central hypothesis asserts enhanced ductility, and the falsification rule requires equal or improved ductility, but the predicted threshold of 25% elongation is below the cited as-cast value of 25.6% and could therefore represent a slight ductility decrease.
